openings.claim: Common allowance may cause size-dependent finished-dimension error.
openings.discriminator: Signed error increases with size rather than operator, direction or design.
openings.probe: Early usable covers across sizes: record cut/sewn dimensions, confounders, corrections and time; wash retained samples in both axes. Revise allowance only if supported.

openings.claim: Corner geometry may impair fit independently of tabletop dimensions.
openings.discriminator: Different seating at equal length/width with rounded versus square corners.
openings.probe: Obtain six customers’ dimensions/corners, prioritizing nominal orders where available; compare pocket interference before revision.
openings.uncertainty: Comparable tables may be unavailable; reference fit cannot establish customer fit.

openings.claim: A measured geometry-to-pattern rule could integrate dimensions, corners, direction and wash change.
openings.discriminator: Corrected patterns reduce fit error on a withheld table configuration.
openings.probe: Use customer measurements and two-axis wash samples; calibrate reference-table pilots, validate independently before releasing similar orders; record time and area waste.
openings.uncertainty: Reproducible fixtures, usable pilots and transfer to later production unproven.

openings.claim: Hidden compliant pockets could absorb bounded corner variation while preserving visible design.
openings.discriminator: Better seating at equal dimensions without design shift.
openings.probe: Compare offcut enclosed-elastic and existing pockets across measured corners: seating, slip, removal before/after five washes; time construction before batch commitment.
openings.uncertainty: Travel, tension, puckering, cost and full-cover performance unproven.

decision: Probe before whole-batch cutting. All changes require ordered sizes/designs, purchased stock, <=8% area waste, five-cycle durability, tool-free removal, existing two machines, <=350 units and three weeks. Success remains unproven: >=38/40 first placements, all designs correct, median work <=32 minutes.
